tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /nyis thog bla brang gi gtsug lag khang mngon dga' bde ba can du bzhugs pa'i rten gtso gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag don gnyis lhun grub bzhugs// na mo gu ru badzra dha ra ya/ dgos 'dod kun stsol rtsa brgyud bla ma dang / /yi dam zhi khro bstan bsrung kun gyi gtso/ /mahā kā la tsa turmu kha bcas/ /'khor dang bcas la 'dud do brtse bas skyongs/ /de la 'dir sgyur byed ces pa sa mo phag lo bzhi thog bla brang gi rig 'dzin lha khang gi 'og gi mgon khang chen mo srid gsum rnam rgyal na bzhugs pa'i rten rnams kyi gzungs gzhug ji ltar bzhugs pa'i dkar chag mdo tsam bkod pa la/ rten thams cad la stod smad bar gsum gyi gzungs sngags kyi rim pa shin tu bzhugs che ba re re dang / mgon po rang gi thun mong ma yin pa'i dregs pa pho rgyud mo rgyud gnyis med rgyud rnams kyi gzungs spel tshig phrin bcol rgyas pa dang bcas shin tu bzhugs che ba gnod sbyin 'khor lo'i bar re re/ sangs rgyas kyi 'phel gdung / bla ma gong ma'i dbu lo kun 'dus/ gdung rus kun 'dus/ na bza' kun 'dus rnams kyi thum che ba re re/ sngags 'chang yab sras gsum gyi dam rdzas 'bum rdo re re/ stong rdo re re/ nged rang gi dam rdzas stobs che ba re re bzhugs shing / sa chen gyi sku la sngags 'chang chen po'i sku 'dra mtshal khrag ma phyag nas stong tshar bzhugs pa rgyal rtse ba bdag pos bzhengs pa/ rje btsun grags pa'i gsol rgyan rigs lnga/ mal lo tsā ba dang rje btsun gyi sku rgyan rus rgyan cha tshang / rje btsun gyi sgom shing kha yig 'byar ma/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku stod/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi sku ber dmar ser nas stobs che ba/ rje rdo rje 'chang gis sems dpa' chen po ngor gyi gdan sa la bkod dus gnang ba'i yin thang gi 'dra bshus kyi rgyab yig la/ rje sa skya pa chen po la/ rje de nyid kyi bla ma dang rje btsun sku mched la sogs pas bskor ba/

dbu rtse rnying ma'i 'jam dbyangs kyi dbu thog na bzhugs pa'i yin thang rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan gyi phyag bris ma khungs btsun zhing byin rlabs che ba las/ bdag kun dga' blo gros kyis dpe zhal bshus te byin rlabs kyi rten du bzhugs par gsol ba btab bo/ /mchog gi dngos grub dam pa myur du thob par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /zhes pa bris pa'i byin rlabs shin tu che ba/ rdo rje phur pa dang / las mkhan ru 'dren dang bcas pa'i 'cham dpe phal cher sngags 'chang chen po'i phyag bris/ yab rje'i phyag bris thor rtsam dang bcas pa'i pod chung gi glegs shing dang / na bza' la sku dreg shin tu che ba dri bzang dang bcas pa/ jo bo rje'i bris thang rnam thar zhing bkod rgyal ba dkon mchog dpal gyi thugs dam/ rgyab yig rgyas pa dang bcas pa/ sngags 'chang chen po'i thugs dam bris thang lnga'i/ gcig gi gtso bo la/ sa chen/ rje btsun sku mched/ birwa pa gtso 'khor gsum/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po/ sa lo dang sngags 'chang chen po rang 'bral med kyi tshul/ gcig la gtso bo sa paṇa/ thub dbang / 'jam dbyangs dmar ser/ ri bo rtse lnga'i bkod pa dang bcas pa/ 'phags pa bla ma dam pa/ sa lo dang sngags 'chang chen po/ gcig la theg chen rin po che/ slob dpon padma/ sa lo/ kun dga' grol mchog spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags/ sgrol dkar/ byams pa/ gcig la gtso bo sa lo gser gyi khri la bzhugs pa/ sgrol ljang / kharsa pa ṇi/ bdag chen ngag pa/ yab bdag chen tsha nas/ sngags 'chang chen po rnams yod pa'i bris thang sngags 'chang gi phyag nas brgya rtsa ma/ sngags 'chang chen po'i ral phod la dmar po las byas pa nang dar ljang khu bub ma nyams pa rdor gong dang bcas pa/ yab rje bde gshegs kyi gsol spangs stag shun ma bub ma nyams pa dri bzang 'phro ba/ spyan snga ngag dbang chos grags dgung lo gya dgu bzhes dus kyi bris thang phyag nas ma/ jo bo rje'i phyag tsha gnyis/

'khon rog gi thugs dam ma lcags kyi rdo rje gnyis rnams bzhugs shing / mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang bzhugs pa'i dkar chag ni 'og tu 'chad la// ༈ /nged rang gi 'dra 'bag la/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po'i kā pa li/ rje btsun rin po che'i gsol zho'i snod rdong phor ma nyams pa/ bram ze dpal 'dzin dang rnal 'byor dbang phyug gi rus rgyan cha tshang / sngags 'chang chen po'i gsol phod sngon po gser ma rdor gong dang bcas pa/ 'jam dbyangs sku mched kyi sku ber phal cher/ 'khon dkon mchog rgyal po dang / sa chen thun mong gi sku ber/ sngags 'chang chen po'i sku brnyan phyag nas brgya tshar ma dang gsol kab ḍa ki dkar mo/ rong ston gyi sku brnyan phyag nas ma/ rje btsun rin po che'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can/ theg chen rin po che'i bris thang phyag nas ma/ gtso bo thub dbang la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba'i bris thang 'phags pa rin po che'i phyag nas ma/ jo bo rje'i phyag tsha gnyis/ 'khon rog gi thugs dam lcags kyi rdo rje gnyis/ nged rang gi tshems dang zhabs sen stobs che ba sogs bzhugs shing // ༈ /sa skya pa chen po'i sku la/ mus chen sems dpa' chen po'i thugs dam ma'i lam 'bras brgyud pa bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor rnams kyi bzhugs tshul thor bkod pa la/ bris thang dang po'i gtso bo la/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/ birwa pa/ nag po pa/ mtha' skor gyi lha phran la/ thub dbang / tshe dpag med/ 'jam dbyangs/ kyai rdor/ 'khor lo bde mchog ku ru kulle/ rnal 'byor ma/ sgrol dkar/ rnam rgyal/ mi g.yo ba dkar po/ gshed dmar/ nor rgyun ma/ gur gyi mgon po rnams dang / bris thang gnyis pa'i gtso bo la/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhwa dhi/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ lha phran la/ thub dbang / 'jam dbyangs/ klu sgrub/ gsang 'dus mi skyod pa/ 'jam rdor/ bla ma rgya gar paṇḍi ta'i cha lugs can bdun dang /

bod kyi bla ma'i sku brnyan gnyis rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang gsum pa'i gtso bo la/ se mkhar chung pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ sa skya pa chen po/ bsod nams rtse mo/ lha phran la/ dkar po rnam gsum/ kyai rdor 'grel lugs/ man ngag lugs/ gur mgon/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ gzhan bod kyi bla ba rab byung gi cha lugs can bzhi dang / yi dam sku mdog dkar po zhal gsum phyag brgyad pa yum dang bcas pa gar stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ ༈ /bris thang bzhi ba'i gtso bo la/ rje btsun/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ lha phran la/ bde mchog lu hi pa/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ ri khrod pa/ lū hi pa/ dha ri ka pa/ rdo rje dril bu/ rus sbal zhabs/ nag po spyod pa/ gu he pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ te lo pa/ gur mgon rnams dang / ༈ /bris thang lnga pa'i gtso bo la/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ lha phran la/ na ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya/ mal lo tsā ba/ gong ma lnga/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ rnal 'byor ma/ gur mgon rnams dang / ༈ /bris thang drug pa'i gtso bo la/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ rje gzhon nu rgyal mchog grub chen nam mkha'i rnal 'byor/ rje sems dpa' chen po/ mtha' skor gyi lha phran la/ thub dbang / rdo rje 'chang / gzhan bla ma rgya gar ba'i cha lugs mdzad pa brgyad dang / bod btsun gyi cha lugs mdzad pa drug 'phags grub/ gur mgon rnams bzhugs shing / de thams cad la kha thi dmar khra'i gong bsham/ zhal khebs nyis sbrags dang bcas pa yod cing // ༈ /yang nged rang gi 'dra 'bag mchod dpon smon lam rin chen gyis bzhengs pa la/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen gyi thugs dam ma lam 'bras brgyud pa'i bris thang grangs brgyad bzhugs pa'i gtso 'khor rnams kyi bkod pa ji ltar yod pa'i tshul brjod pa la/ thog mar bris thang dang po'i gtso bo/ rdo rje 'chang / bdag med ma/

birwa pa/ mtha' skor gyi lha phran la/ ḍoṃ bhi wa/ a la la badzra/ nags khrod pa/ garbha ri/ rje btsun bsod snyoms pa/ mi thub zla ba/ dpa' bo'i rdo rje/ shākya ye shes/ gsal ba'i snying po/ bcom ldan 'das shākya thub pa/ gur mgon/ sgrol dkar/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang gnyis pa'i gtso bo la/ nag po pa/ ḍā ma ru pa/ a wa dhu ti/ lha phran la/ rje sgyi chu ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ rje btsun bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ 'gro ba'i mgon po 'phags pa/ dga' ldan pa bkra shis dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge / tshe dpag med/ gur mgon/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang gsum pa'i gtso bo la/ ga ya dha ra/ 'brog mi shākya ye shes/ se mkhar chung pa/ lha phran la/ rdo rje 'chang / phyag na rdo rje/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub/ shā wa ri pa/ lo hi pa/ rdo rje dril bu pa/ rus sbal zhabs/ dha ri ka pa/ dza lan dha ri pa/ gu he pa/ rnam rgyal zhabs/ nag po pa/ ti lo pa/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ dgyes pa rdo rje/ gur gyi mgon po/ rnam rgyal/ chos rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang bzhi pa'i gtso bo la/ zhang ston chos 'bar/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon bsod nams rtse mo/ mtha' skor gyi lha phran la/ shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo tsā ba/ sa chen/ bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang ston/ brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bzang po/ sems dpa' chen po/ bsod nams seṅge / dkon mchog blo gros/ 'khor lo bde mchog grub rgyal lugs kyi tshe dpag med/ gur mgon/ sgrol ljang / 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang //

༈ /bris thang lnga pa'i gtso bo la/ rje btsun grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇḍi ta/ 'phags pa/ lha phran la/ mar me mdzad/ dpal bde ba/ sangs rgyas ye shes zhabs/ bi ma la gupta/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje/ ratna badzra/ ratna kirti/ paṇa ta pa/ gnyan lo/ gnam kha'u pa/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ rje btsun grags pa/ sa paṇa/ gsang 'dus 'jam rdor/ gur mgon/ sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang drug pa'i gtso bo la/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ blo gros brtan pa/ lha phran la/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa/ shes rab brtsegs/ mal lo/ sa chen/ rtse mo/ grags pa rgyal mtshan/ sa paṇa/ 'phags pa/ zhang ston/ brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa/ ye shes rgyal mtshan/ kun dga' bzang po/ dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ bsod nams seṅge/ dkon mchog blo gros/ rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ dpal ldan tshul khrims/ gur mgon/ rje sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang bdun pa'i gtso bo la/ bla ma dpal ldan tshul khrims/ grub chen buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ lha phran la/ birwa pa/ ḍoṃ bhi wa/ ye shes mkha' 'gro/ bi taṃ ḍi pa/ gshin rje gshed ma/ kambhi ra/ ra went+ra/ chos rje pa/ laṅka de wa/ mdo sde pa/ lo tsā mchog ldan/ dpal ldan seṅge/ gshang lo tsā ba/ kun spangs chos grags/ sa bzang 'phags pa/ rje kun dga' bzang po/ ma ti paṇa chen/ rje dkon mchog rgyal mtshan/ rje sangs rgyas dpal bzang / gshin rje gshed dmar/ dzam ser/ gur mgon/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rnams dang // ༈ /bris thang brgyad pa'i gtso bo la/ sems dpa' chen po/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seṅge / ldan pa/ buddha shrī/ rdo rje 'chang kun dga' bzang po/ chos rje dkon mchog 'phel/ dges pa rdo rje/ gur gyi mgon po/ rdo rje rnam 'joms/ 'jam dbyangs sangs rgyas rin chen rnams kyi sku brnyan bzhugs shing / de thams cad la gos bsham gos ljang kha me tog ldum rtsis la/

zhal kheb nyis brtsegs grab gcig rnams yod do// ༈ /de ltar gdan sa dpal ldan sa skya yi/ /sngon gyi nyis thog bla brang byung ba'i sar/ /mngon dga' bde ba can du mtshan gsol ba'i/ /gtsug lag khang chen gsar du bzhengs pa yi/ /rten gtso gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug bzhugs tshul gyi/ /dkar chag 'di ni sngags 'chang rdo rje 'dzin/ /ngag dbang kun dga' bsod nams zhes bya bas/ /sa phag sa ga zla ba'i dmar cha yi/ /bzang po'i tshes la bzhi thog bla brang gi /gnas mchog 'od gsal snang bar sbyar ba yi/ /yi ge pa ni rnam dpyod spyan yangs pa'i/ /mi dbang rnam rgyal rdo rje zhes byas bgyis/ /legs byas 'dis mtshon dus gsum dge ba'i mthus/ /bdag cag dpon slob yid la re ba yi/ /don kun mthar phyin phyi ma lhan cig par/ /dag pa'i zhing skyes don gnyis lhun grub shog /sarba maṅga laṃ/ thams cad bkra shis/ shu bha mastu sarb+ba dza ga taṃ/ dge bar gyur cig skye dgu rnams la'o// // ༈ mkhan chen a pad rin po che'i dgongs bzhed ltar gu rus zhabs zhu bgyis pa'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 6 a myes zhabs/ gtsug lag khang mngon dga' bde ba can gyi rten gtso gnyis kyi gzungs gzhug gi dkar chag PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 5
